properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 27 at 1:59PM MDT until July 27 at 2:45PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
At 159 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 4 miles south of
Burlington, moving south at 5 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Burlington.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 70 in Colorado between mile markers 430 and 450.
Highway 385 between mile markers 174 and 198.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 27 at 1:36PM MDT until July 27 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible, flooding
caused by excessive rainfall over the Gold Mountain Fire Burn Scar
is possible.

* WHERE...Gold Mountain Fire Burn Scar in Ouray County Colorado,
including Dexter and Cutler Creek drainages and Highway 550.

* WHEN...Until 445 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall is possible over the Gold Mountain
Burn Scar which could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and
other loose materials.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 133 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.areaDesc: Gunnison, CO; Hinsdale, CO; Ouray, CO

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 27 at 12:38PM MDT until July 27 at 3:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Portions of west central Colorado, including the following
counties, Mesa and Montrose and Utah, including the following
counties, Grand and San Juan.

* WHEN...Until 345 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1238 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.4 and 0.8 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
mainly rural areas of Southwestern Mesa, Western Montrose,
Southeastern Grand and Northeastern San Juan Counties
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.areaDesc: Mesa, CO; Montrose, CO; Grand, UT; San Juan, UT
